posts.headline: Choose the welcome sign size that fits your space

posts.scene_prompt: wooden easel with 24x36 sign, smaller 16x24 and 12x18 signs leaning nearby, soft window light, eucalyptus garland
posts.pin_title: Celebration of Life Welcome Sign Template — Three Sizes Included
posts.caption: Every venue is different. The Soft Botanical kit gives you all three welcome sign sizes in one download so you can print the one that fits your entryway. Fill in the free Adobe Reader app, save, and print at a local shop.

posts.headline: Honor their memory at the Thanksgiving table
posts.subline: Place a memory card at each seat for quiet sharing
posts.scene_prompt: Thanksgiving table setting with cream linens, sage napkins, a memory card at each place with a pen, small pumpkin centerpiece, candlelight
posts.pin_title: Thanksgiving Memory Cards — Printable Share-a-Memory for the Holiday Table
posts.caption: The first holiday without them is hard. Tuck a share-a-memory card into each place setting so family can write a favorite story between courses. Cards print four per letter page, match the program and welcome sign.
posts.alt_text: A Thanksgiving table with cream and sage linens; at each place a 4.25x5.5 memory card and pen sit beside the plate, a small pumpkin and candle center the table.

posts.headline: Add photos to the program on your computer
posts.subline: Drag and drop into the fill-in PDF — no design skills needed
posts.scene_prompt: laptop open to Adobe Reader showing program cover with photo placeholder, printed proof beside it, reading glasses, cup of tea, morning light
posts.pin_title: How to Add Photos to a Fill-In PDF Funeral Program — Desktop Tutorial
posts.caption: Photos go in on a computer. Open the PDF in free Adobe Acrobat Reader, click the photo box, choose your file, and it drops in perfectly sized. Print a test page at home, then send the final to your print shop.
posts.alt_text: A laptop screen shows the Soft Botanical program cover in Adobe Reader with a photo being dropped into the placeholder; a printed proof lies next to the keyboard in soft morning light.

posts.headline: Print at Staples, FedEx, or Walgreens
posts.subline: Save the PDF to a USB or email — pick up same day
posts.art_prompt: soft watercolor sage leaves and cream paper texture, empty center space, calm light, no text
posts.caption: No home printer? Save the filled PDF to a USB drive or email it to Staples, FedEx Office, or Walgreens. Choose 32 lb paper for a nice feel. Pick up in hours. Link in bio for the kit.
posts.alt_text: A calm watercolor scene of sage leaves and cream paper; overlay text reads 'Print at Staples, FedEx, or Walgreens — save PDF to USB or email, pick up same day.'
posts.video_script: Hook: No printer at home? No problem. Beat 1: Show filled PDF on phone → tap Share → save to Files or email to self. Beat 2: Open Staples/FedEx/Walgreens site → upload PDF → choose 32 lb paper, double-sided. Beat 3: Confirm pickup time → show 'Ready in 2 hours' screen. Close: Link in bio for the fill-in PDF kit — $12.99 with code PEACE25.

posts.headline: Build a memory table in three steps
posts.subline: Welcome sign, memory cards, photos — done in minutes
posts.art_prompt: soft watercolor scene: wooden easel with welcome sign, stack of memory cards in a basket, framed photos, pillar candles, eucalyptus, warm cream/sage palette, empty center for text
posts.caption: A memory table welcomes guests and holds their stories. 1) Stand the welcome sign on an easel. 2) Set out memory cards with pens and a basket. 3) Add a few framed photos and a candle. All matching, all printable. Shop the kit at the link in bio.
posts.alt_text: A painted watercolor scene showing a memory table: welcome sign on easel, basket of memory cards with pens, framed photos, candles, and eucalyptus in sage and cream tones.
posts.video_script: Hook: A memory table takes 10 minutes and means everything. Beat 1: Place welcome sign on easel (show 24x36, then 16x24). Beat 2: Fan out memory cards in a basket with two pens. Beat 3: Add two framed photos and a pillar candle. Close: Everything matches — program, sign, cards. Get the kit at foreverheld.pages.dev, code PEACE25 saves 25%.
